nom: TATCHA The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

avis.texte: It's an average makeup remover & cleanser, skin wasn't particularly soft or hydrated after use. Other products are comparable at a lower price point (purity made simple by Philosophy).

I love the products. Use them alot. Even when i run out, i find myself going back for more. Tge price is a bit higher than other oroducts, but you dont need alot. The cleanses your face while moisturizing it. No break outs.

avis.titre: No breakouts with Acne Prone Skin - Perfect First Cleanse
avis.texte: I was nervous about using an oil cleanser with acne prone skin, but it rinses clean and has not caused any breakouts. My skin feels soft and calm, not tight or irritated. It takes off my makeup really well (even my mascara) and has been the perfect first cleanse. It's super gentle and feels moisturizing, which is good because I follow with a second cleanser. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Wish I didn't love Tatcha products because of the price
avis.texte: I have combination skin that feels dry underneath and oily on top. I use powder papers to mop my face during the day because it gets so oily. I was afraid oil cleanser would make my skin oilier but somehow this did NOT - it actually makes it seem less oily and less dry at the same time. This is so expensive, I bought Peach & Lily oil cleanser attempting to find a less expensive alternative, and there's no comparison. I will just have to bite the bullet and spend the $ on this. I rarely write reviews, but I love this stuff.
I love everything about this high priced cleansing oil. It feels luxurious and the packaging is A+. Even though it's pricey, I will make it one of my routine luxury purchases.
I really wanted to live this but the amount of product needed is more than the video implies, so not worth the money to me. Will be returning.
It is perfection, suitable for sensitive skin. I have been using it for 3 years and continue to repurchase. Removes makeup effortlessly. Leave skin feeling hydrated and clean.

I never thought I'd love an oil cleanser. I have combination skin and thought an oil would be awful. Boy was I wrong! A little goes a long way and it's so soft and luxurious. It removes eye makeup without stinging my eyes or without lots of rubbing. Afterwards, my skin isn't greasy and it feels soft and smooth. LOVE!

avis.titre: Great product would give 5 stars but for bottle
avis.texte: I love this and all other Tatcha products I have tried However as with other Tatcha products I am frustrated with the product bottlecontainer The lid does not snap closed and if I pick the product up by the lid the bottom part containing the product falls off putting it at risk of hitting the floor and breaking I used to use The Rice Wash which I love but stopped buying it because 95 of the time the lid snapped off because the quotjointquot affixing it to the bottle is too weak These sorts of things are unacceptable for the price point Tatcha products are great and packaging is beautiful but the containers need some quality control work If this continues I will need to discontinue using the Camellia Cleansing Oil as well I don't like having high end products in flimsy broken containers Not only do they look unsightly but the product spills all over
